capabilities: copy a table cell's value to the clipboard with one click
show a copy icon when hovering a table cell in Reading view or Live Preview
toggle a notification shown after each copy
extras: Notes that copying does not read the clipboard and that copied values may appear in the OS clipboard history; copied Veilbit-masked secrets reveal their real text, though the on-screen mask stays.
problem: Obsidian has no quick way to copy a single cell's value from a Markdown table without manually selecting the text.

relations.evidence: A Veilbit secret in the cell is copied as its real text.

summary: One-click table cell copy utility that shows a copy icon when you hover a Markdown table cell in Reading view or Live Preview.
